programme.title: 軍官與魔鬼
programme.desc: A young Navy lawyer risks his career to uncover the truth during a military trial.

programme.title: 律政俏佳人
programme.desc: When Elle, a sorority queen, is dumped by her boyfriend as he plans to go to law school, she enrols in the same school to win him back. However, she discovers that there is more to her than her looks.

programme.title: 手札情緣
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power and beauty of true love.

programme.title: 女兒的女兒
programme.desc: Now a widow in her sixties, Aixia must become a mother once more when she receives custody of her daughter's daughter – in the form of a fertilized embryo left by Aixia's daughter Zuer, who tragically died in a car accident. However, Aixia already has a second daughter: Emma, who Aixia abandoned as a teenager, and the shame over abandoning Emma has never faded.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 証人
programme.desc: A traffic accident changed their lives forever. In capturing wanted criminal Zhang Yidong, Sergeant Tang Fei was involved in a gunfight and car accident that put the criminal in a coma. But in the process he also crippled an fellow officer, and mistakenly shot dead the elder daughter of public prosecutor and single mother Gao Min. Unable to handle the guilt, Tang Fei succumbs to a fog of pain. Gao Min, meanwhile, pours all her love and attention to her younger daughter Ling. Three months later, the criminal Zhang Yidong awakens from his coma. Gao Min, who had been working hard on bringing him to justice, insists he stand trial immediately.

programme.title: 反詐師奶兵團
programme.desc: The scammer who scammed my money asked for help! Duk-hee, an energetic woman looking into various loans due to a laundry fire, receives a call from a bank clerk named Son offering a reasonable loan. Sending money to Son who demanded various fee for the loan, she later realizes that the entire process was a voice phishing scam, leaving her in shock. Having lost her entire fortune and forced to live on the streets with her children, Duk-hee receives another call from Son one day... This time, it's a plea for help! Determined to rescue the scammer and recover her lost money, Duk-hee equips herself with various skills and, along with her colleagues, who are equally determined, to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: 第一刑事部的烏鴉
programme.desc: Two years have passed since Michio Irima left first criminal court (commonly known as “Ichikei”). Michio is transferred to Setouchi in Okayama Prefecture, where he is assigned to an assault case involving the youngest Minister of Defense in history. His investigations lead him to look into a collision incident involving an Aegis warship, but the details of the ships voyage are a national secret. Michio is now faced with an adversary upon which the threat of “official authority” does not work. Meanwhile, Chizuru Sakama, who has tried numerous cases with Michio, is working as a lawyer in a neighboring town under a work experience program. There, she takes on a case involving a large local company which supports the whole town, but not all is as it seems...Between these seemingly disparate cases, a shocking truth arises. Are they opening a Pandora's Box that was best left alone?

programme.title: 妃子笑
programme.desc: In the ancient Chinese dynasties, there were thousands concubines but only one Princess in the palace. To be the only one, girls fought by all means. Two beauties, Mandy came from poor family and Pearl came from aristocracy. They became soul mates and swore they were friends forever and would help each other on the way to the Princess Selection. But they discovered that there was only one girl could be the Princess, and things became different. To execute the enemies, to strive for the throne and the luxury life, girls bribed, rigged, poisoned and framed each other. They ever knew the cost for the throne was far beyond their expectation..

programme.title: 點對點
programme.desc: Chung returns from Canada to a drastically transformed Hong Kong and hoping to capture the city in his childhood years, graffitis a cryptic diagram near every subway station, in the form of dot-to-dot games. Soon they are discovered by Xue, a Putonghua teacher from China determined to solve these riddles as she immerses herself in our city's culture and history..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 出「奇」致富: 闔家辣
programme.desc: The COVID-19 pandemic offered white-collar workers everywhere the chance to work from home. At first, it seemed like a luxury to be able to work outside the shackles of the office, but people quickly realized that it could also drive them insane. For Coba, work-from-home has led to a daily cage match with his family. When he inadvertently learns that his mother's homemade chili sauce is a hit with his co-workers, he convinces his family to turn the chili sauce into an online business in order to divert their attention away from conflicts. However, Coba didn't expect that the sauce would become a timely internet sensation, thanks to families eating at home more often during the pandemic.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 傷城
programme.desc: In a city of love and prosperity, a city of lost hope and premature death, veteran detective Hei feels it all: the hurt, the helplessness, the horror. When his father-in-law, the billionaire benefactor Chau, is gruesomely murdered in his palatial mansion, he enlists the assistance of his former partner turned private detective, Bong.

programme.title: 午夜天鵝
programme.desc: Nagisa is transgender. She grew up in Hiroshima as a man, but now lives in Shinjuku, Tokyo as a woman. Due to an incident, she begins to live with middle school student Ichika, who is a distant relative. Ichika has been neglected by her mother Saori. From living in solitude by herself, to now living with Ichika, Nagisa develops maternal instincts for the first time.

programme.title: 死屍死時四十四
programme.desc: A dead body and a hotchpotch of homeowners in a residential building on a single night: all hell breaks loose. As the Jewish axiom has it, “man thinks; God laughs.” On a night like any other, Ming, together with his wife and mother-in-law, finds an anonymous naked dead body lying at their doorstep. They might not know who the body was, but they have no doubt that their unit will become a “murder home” once this is exposed. Its property value will nosedive, and they will be transformed from blissful homeowners to miserable victims. So they decide to pass the buck to their neighbours. There are eleven living residents in four units on the same floor. Besides Ming's family of five, there are the retired elderly couple, Mr. & Mrs. Chan; the single lady Mary and her maid; and the Cheung's, an irascible father and his cantankerous son. Last but not least, there is this mysterious woman from an upper floor who chain smokes. This motley group of residents start fighting against one a.

programme.title: 網戰特攻隊
programme.desc: Talented yet arrogant city desk journalist Lim Sang-jin investigates corruption within the major corporation Manjun, only to have his report debunked as a hoax, leading to his integrity being questioned. “Your article wasn't false. It was a trick that we orchestrated” Then one day, a suspicious tip is sent to Lim. The mysterious whistleblower introduces himself as a member of the online opinion manipulation team known as Team Alep, which fabricated both truth and lies for the right price...Where does the truth begin and the lie end.

programme.title: 臥底型警 FINAL
programme.desc: Reiji Kikukawa graduated from the police academy with the worst record in its history. One day out of the blue, this straightforward, overly hot-blooded cop with a weakness for women is assigned to an undercover investigation as “The Mole”! He is ordered to infiltrate Japan's most feared yakuza organization in order to arrest its leader, Shuho Todoroki. Reiji goes deep undercover and his final mission is to stop the biggest illegal drug trade in history worth USD 6 billion which takes place on a luxury cruise ship sailing around the world.

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: Bodyguard, The follows a retired bodyguard (Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world where China, Russia and North Korea meet. Suffering from the beginnings of dementia, Bodyguard, The is befriended by a young girl whose life is threatened when her father (Lau) falls in with the local crime world. When the girl and her father disappear, Bodyguard, The must call upon his long forgotten skills to save the life of his young friend.

programme.title: JSA安全地帶
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight..

programme.title: 竊聽風雲2
programme.desc: LAW Man-seng is one of the most reputable securities dealers in Hong Kong. One day, he drives his luxury sports car and notices that a car is tailing him. His car finally crashes and Law is sent to the hospital. At the hospital, he sees a police officer HO Chi-keung, and thinks the officer is here for the car accident. But Ho works for the Department of Homeland Security which is responsible for counter-terrorism. Ho has found some surveillance devices in the wreckage of Law's sports car which are for military use..

programme.title: 王的盛宴
programme.desc: The early history of a nation unfolds through the actions of three heroes – Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Han Xin – who chased their dreams of uniting a warring nation and fought through major milestones of the Chu-Han Contention years in the third century. From the Julu War to the Hongmen Banquet, the Gaixia War to the death of HanXin, the narration of Liu Bang – who would be the founding emperor of the new Han Dynasty – sets the stage for a tale of betrayal and brothers at war, where the last man standing inherits a nation.

programme.title: 人生轉運站
programme.desc: The great adventure stories of worn goods that build bridges between people from all walks of life, following a former baseball player, a sleepless student, a new hangman, an imprisoned gangster, and a mysterious father and daughter. Kwang-sung was once a rising baseball star but he is now a desperate man, cold, hungry, hunted by two hitmen. One day he receives a call from a little boy Jae-ha who asks him to sell his baseball jacket. Na-na is Jae-ha's English teacher who is trying to investigate a murder case that Kwang-sung must be involved. Ye-ji helps Kwang-sung's escape when she sells Min-hyuk a sleep-time controller. Her brother Soo-jung is a hangman who actually wants to be a rock star. Jae-ha's uncle Seok-ho visits a story hunter and his mysterious daughter to sell off his old bittersweet memories. When they are about to shake hands, Anna Karenina suddenly comes in. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exciting c.

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 出「奇」致富: 肌智整容大叔
programme.desc: The most glamorous part of Seoul, Apgujeong thrives with new possibilities. Dae-guk who is a native of Apgujeong and rules its ground, is eager to start his own groundbreaking plastic surgery business. Then he encounters Ji-woo, the most talented surgeon in the area who lost his medical license due to someone sabotaging his reputation. Dae-guk effortlessly comes up with an idea to make this business happen, and he does everything he can to make Ji-woo his partner. Together, Dae-guk and Ji-woo open a whole new era of Apgujeong.

programme.title: 聖誕玫瑰
programme.desc: Tim is a defence attorney with a heart of gold. Refusing to be simply a hired gun for his clients, he quits his high-powered job to become a prosecutor for the Justice Department. With the support of fiancee Megan and cop buddy Nam, Tim decides to start afresh. When he meets a handicapped piano teacher, Jing, who urges him to help her. She is accusing her doctor, Zhou a renowned surgeon of sexual harassment during a routine check-up. But with no witnesses and only their own conflicting testimonies, a Rashomon-like mystery unfolds. To make matters worse, Zhou's defence attorney, Freddy, is Tim's successor at his old law firm, and proves to be Tim's toughest opponent to-date. As a media frenzy encircles the case, it slowly destroys the lives of everyone involved.

programme.title: 潛行
programme.desc: In the new century, the fight against drugs faces an unprecedented and difficult challenge! Under the deep and complex dark network, an invisible war is being waged in Hong Kong...... Typhoon signal was hoisted in Hong Kong. Under the cover of the fierce wind, four tons of methamphetamine were entering Hong Kong, pending to be sold on the dark network. A cyber revelry of druggies was about to be unveiled, and a storm was brewing in the quiet Victoria Harbour. Police had to arrest the “boss” behind the scenes and nip the “drug network” in the bud in no time, that pushed their undercover intelligence to the narrow road. In the center of the storm, undercover agents, police officers, drug lords, black, white, and gray entangled.

programme.title: 中國合伙人
programme.desc: 80's. 3 undergraduates share a common ambition - to live the American dream. They establish a tutorial school New Vision, yet the sudden fame are tearing their friendship apart..

programme.title: 閨密盜賞團
programme.desc: In 1970s South Korea, women free divers who have harvested shellfish suffer a threat to their livelihoods after a chemical factory opens in their seaside village. Using their specialty in diving and knowledge of the waters, old friends Choon-ja and Jin-sook start to smuggle goods. However, when they find out they are being set up, they plan for the most mind-bending and dangerous job to seek revenge, which could become their biggest break-or the end of it all.

programme.title: 超越
programme.desc: Tianyi Wu, a young 100-meter-running champion, returns to his hometown, aiming to get off his chest the failure to surpass his former teammate, Chaoyue Hao. But he doesn't expect to see that Chaoyue's life is in shambles as well. They retreat to the memories of their lives, both shared and separate, in an attempt to lift each other up from their current situation.

programme.title: 烏托邦浩劫
programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake.While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.

programme.title: 投名狀
programme.desc: In the fall of 1870, General Pang stands high atop the city walls fully attired in governor's robes. Peering down upon the site of his inauguration, he is filled with dreams and ambition. Pang has taken a path of no return; had he chosen differently, he might have been one of the heroes to later overthrow the corrupt Qing imperial regime and establish a new China. He could have changed the course of history. But two bandits and a woman have changed the course of his life, helping him achieve his goal, but ultimately causing his demise. The two bandits are his sworn blood brothers: Zhao Er-Hu and Jiang Wu-Yang..

programme.title: 竊聽風雲3
programme.desc: Five Years ago, LAW was jailed for killing a major land owner in a car accident. At that time LAW worked as a chauffeur for the rural tycoon LUK. It was rumored that LUK was behind such land owner's death, which gave LUK a competitive edge in the native apartment development deal. Before the Hong Kong handover in 1997, every native, male resident in the New Territories was granted the right to build a house. Yet it had caused social unrest over the land right, until recently the government decided to gather all of the remaining land rights from these residents and plan to build taller apartment buildings. LUK wished to swallow the enormous project and this started the fights between LUK, the land owner and other real estate developers. When LAW gets out of prison five years later, the world has changed..

programme.title: 親愛的
programme.desc: When their son goes missing, TIAN and his ex-wife find their lives thrown into turmoil. Years later, they have been tipped to find their lost son, but he sees them as strangers..

programme.title: EXIT：極限逃生
programme.desc: Yong-nam was one of the best rock climbers in college but hasn't had much luck elsewhere after graduation. He has failed to get a job for many years and has to rely on his parents just to get by. For his mother's 70th birthday, he insisted on having the party at Dream Garden because his old crush, Eui-ju works there. When a disaster strikes, covering an entire district in Seoul with mysterious white gas, he has to use all of his rock climbing skills with the help of Eui-ju to get everyone to safety..

programme.title: LAST MILE：全面引爆
programme.desc: On the day before the Black Friday sale, a box delivered by a global e-commerce company, explodes. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web.

programme.title: 出「奇」致富: 一點就到家
programme.desc: This is a youth-comedy version of American Dreams in China (2013). Wei Jinbei (played by Liu Haoran), Peng Xiubing (Peng Yuchang) and Li Shaoqun (Yin Fang) are young men of very different personalities. One had tried many times to find success in e-commerce but had failed on every turn in a big city. The other is a village lad, with nothing on his mind but the chase for success. The third one is consumed by romantic visions of life, divorced entirely from reality. They had separately returned from the city to an antiquated town in Yunnan. Brought together by fate, they decided to launch an e-commerce business together. They might have stumbled upon a great idea, but the state-of-the-art nature of their technological pursuit puts them at odds with the fogeyish ways of the very traditional town. With resolve and sincerity, they managed to win over everyone, entering into the eventful journey of a tech startup, a journey at once earnest, vibrant and surreal.

programme.title: 殺人預言
programme.desc: One day, the dead body of Min-tae only brother Seok-tae was found, and Seok-tae ‘s wife Moon-young has disappeared. While searching for clues on this brother's death, Min-tae found that a novelist Ho-ryung also following the same trail and he discovered that the death of his brother was predicted in Ho-ryung's bestselling novel, ‘Nocturnal.' Min-tae was thrown into confusion and brother's gang and police also getting involved in the case. To find out the truth behind brother's death, Min-tae began a relentless and furious pursuit..

programme.title: 黑的教育
programme.desc: On the night of their high school graduation, three juvenile delinquents find themselves getting drunk at their regular hangout, throwing beer bottles and enjoying the abuse hurled at them by nearby residents. But for these young men about to enter a new chapter of life, this little bit of chaos is nowhere near enough to farewell their dying youth. Before dawn, they decide to share their deepest, darkest secret with one another. After all, only true “bros” are qualified to know their most unspeakable deed..

programme.title: 小心陷井
programme.desc: Shunsuke Kawamura worked in a real estate company and was always the best of the best when it came to sales. He was going to marry the daughter of the CEO of his company, but then, something unexpected happened...Just before the day of his wedding, he attended a surprise party held by his colleagues and got drunk. On his way home, he accidentally fell into a deep manhole. By the time he woke up, it was already midnight. What was even worse was that his right leg was heavily injured and he could neither contact the police nor find out his current location using GPS. The only person he could contact was his ex-girlfriend, but she did not believe in his words. He started to believe that he might have been set up by someone, so he decided to set up a new Twitter account named “Manhole Girl”, hoping that with the help of the internet, he could locate himself and call out for help. Netizens excitedly assisted him to search for the suspect.

programme.title: 12.12：首爾之春
programme.desc: After the assassination of President Park, martial law has been declared. A coup d'etat bursts out by Defense Security Commander CHUN Doo-gwang and a private band of officers following him. Capital Defense Commander LEE Tae-shin, an obstinate soldier who believes the military should not take political actions, fights against CHUN Doo-gwang to stop him. The conflict between the two grows while military leaders are holding their decision and Defense Minister is gone. In the midst of chaos, the spring of Seoul that everyone longed for heads to unexpected direction.

programme.title: 龍虎門
programme.desc: Tiger gets the Lousha Death Plaque accidentally, which represents the power to control Lousha Gate. During his celebration the gang ambushes Tiger, who knows zero of the Plaque..

programme.title: 左輪殺姬
programme.desc: 'I'm getting the money I'm owed, why should I prepare myself? ”Su-young, a police officer waiting to move into her dream apartment, gets entangled in an unexpected corruption case. She accepts an offer to take all the blame in exchange for a large reward. Two years later, on the day of her release from prison, the only person who comes to see her is Yoon-sun, a woman she has never met before. Su-young senses that something has gone wrong. Determined to regain everything she has lost, Su-young sets out to find Andy, who promised her the reward, but she soon encounters an even bigger and more dangerous force behind him..

programme.title: 暴瘋語
programme.desc: Three years ago, FAN (LAU Ching Wan) had a schizophrenic breakdown and killed his wife (Michelle YE Xuan). He later attempted to commit suicide but was unsuccessful, and was eventually sentenced to rehabilitate in a psychiatric facility indefinitely. Dr. CHOW (HUANG Xiao Ming) is FAN's psychiatrist. He believes FAN is cured after 3-year treatment and is alone in opposition to all doctors' objections to discharge FAN. After releasing from the facility, FAN faces discrimination and misunderstanding and once again finds himself at the brink of collapse. One night, he mistakenly kills a drug addict on impulse. He is driven to despair and comes to Dr. CHOW for help.Having thought about it, Dr CHOW fears his career will be wrecked if it is uncovered and therefore helps FAN abscond. The concealment of the truth subtly snowballs into chaos as it triggers media criticism and attacks due to his missing murderous patient. In order to redeem himself, CHOW decides to cure FAN with a confi.

programme.title: 愛情扯大纜
programme.desc: A story of the sad love between a man who dedicates his youth to the nearly 420-year-old tradition of the Sendai Grand Tug-of-War, and a Korean medical resident who works on Koshiki island, and what happens with them and their families.

programme.title: 堅如磐石
programme.desc: Su Jianming, the son of Deputy Mayor Zheng Gang of Jinjiang City, defies his father's counsel and attends a cunning dinner invitation from the wealthiest man in Jinjiang City, Li Zhitian. To his astonishment, he becomes an unwilling witness to a shocking incident where someone is coerced into thrusting their hand into a simmering hotpot. As past mysteries resurface, hidden factions from various quarters plot and scheme, employing intricate strategies, scrutiny, and suspicion. Amidst the web of conflicting desires, the pressing question remains: who will ultimately unveil the final mask.

programme.title: 朝花夕拾．芳華絕代
programme.desc: 2013, after the auction of items from Anita's estate, seemingly insignificant items are transported to a garbage dump. A number of fans try to salvage what they can in the dead of night. Undeterred by the conditions or the imminent threat of arrest, they work meticulously to save each of these treasures. Handwritten cards, letters and small hand-crafted gifts from fans, some even forgotten by the people who originally made them, every single one of these seemingly insignificant items kept and lovingly treasured by Anita over the years. Not wanting Anita's treasures to be condemned to landfills, these fans save and endeavour to return each of these to their original owner. Through their journey back to their original owner, we trace the stories of several fans whose lives were touched and forever changed by their chance encounters with their idol. Stories of: Growing confidence, Inspiration, Courage, Rekindled faith in people, and Friendship. Life may end but love and memorie.

programme.title: 24小時救參行動
programme.desc: A group of Korean tourists is taken hostage by an extremist Taliban group in Afghanistan. The Korean government dispatches Jae-ho, known as one of Korea's most skilled diplomats, in order to handle the situation. Once he arrives, he asks for the Afghan government's cooperation and uses every means possible to free the hostages. However, his efforts go in vain. Due to his failure, he's forced to work with Dae-sik, a special agent who is an expert on the Middle East. As they begin making their move to get to the Taliban, the first hostage death occurs. With nowhere else to turn, the two become unlikely allies in a race against time to save the rest of the hostages.

programme.title: 放‧逐
programme.desc: Two hit men from Hong Kong sent to take out a renegade member trying to turn over a new leaf with his wife and newborn baby. They soon find themselves in the throes of a dilemma when two of their former associates also show up, intent on thwarting them at every cost..

programme.title: 出「奇」致富: 欺詐女王
programme.desc: Ji-hye is a once-successful and beautiful swindler, who recently begins failing with her cons and dreams of changing her small-job life. Before her retirement, she decides to take on one last job which could change her whole life: seducing the son of a wealthy art broker family to steal the golden treasure hidden in their secret mansion. With the help of her daughter Ju-young, she succeeds in earning the trust of the family but it turns out to be a never-ending battle. Can Ji-hye and Ju-young find the legendary treasure and start a new life.

programme.title: 不義之戰
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive..

programme.title: 該死的阿修羅
programme.desc: During the night of his 18th birthday, Jan-Wen committed a random shooting homicide in the crowed night-market, with his self-made modified gun and for some mysterious reasons. The tragic incident caused the life of his family and friends, the victims, and the witnesses all facing the tremendous impact in the aftermath. Ching is getting married with Ng Lam who grew up in a wealthy family. Though it seems to be an accident, Wan feels that something is unusual. Wan first investigate the background of Ching and finds that her mother was died in a fire accident fifteen years ago also. Before that, Ching and her mother were in a difficult relationship, Lo Chi Fung was the only person Ching could talk to. They both grew up in Pak Sin Town and disappeared together after the accident happened. Wan perseveres in the investigation but the case just like falling into the mist as everyone related to Ching are all hiding some secrets. The turning point comes out until Lo Chi Fung and his girlfriend Lam Yam show up. The two fatal cases are crossing fifteen years, everyone can be suspected. As eerie messages and calls pull Lily into Xiaoya's ghost world, she learns of the spirit's desire for revenge against those who hurt her. Empathizing with Xiaoya's pain, Lily begins to understand the quest for justice. However, she soon realizes that helping Xiaoya seek vengeance comes at a steep cost, and some hauntings can never truly be escaped.

programme.desc: Manhunt follows the journey of upstanding lawyer Du Qiu, who is unwittingly drawn into a murder case when all the evidence at the scene points to him being the perpetrator. Knowing that he's been framed by Luo Zhi, Du Qiu runs from the law to uncover the truth. The police launch a large-scale manhunt, but veteran detective Yamura sees that this seemingly open-and-shut case is not that simple after all. During the intense pursuit, a bond begins to build between the fugitive and his pursuer, even though Yamura knows that he can't fully trust Du Qiu. Is the real killer lurking elsewhere? Is there a hidden conspiracy behind the murder.

On the contrary, also filled with our hope and despair. Some of their lives are in danger because of human's selfishness and ruthlessness. 'Once They Were Here ' tells the fate from different animals on the choice of human. Perhaps it is not pure love and random. The so-called equality of life is only reflected in the uninterrupted heartbeat.

programme.title: 聽見兩個世界
programme.desc: Dai is born to deaf parents and has been raised with deep love in rural Japan. However, as he grows older, he becomes troubled by his differences from others and begins to blame his deaf mother for his daily frustrations. When he turns 20, Dai leaves home for Tokyo as if to escape. Life in Tokyo was lonely at first, but when Dai starts working as a magazine reporter, he finds fulfillment in meeting a diverse group of people. Time eventually passes, and Dai returns home for the first time in eight years. In spending peaceful time with his deaf mother after a long time, a memory that has been sealed away unexpectedly comes back to Dai.

programme.title: 來福大酒店
programme.desc: To raise funds for his father, Sanqing, who has faced social ostracism, goes undercover at the Life Hotel near the hospital, aiming to disrupt its operations and coerce owner Xiao Lin into agreeing to its demolition. However, as they spend time together, Sanqing forms bonds with the hotel's residents and learns of the guests' life stories. His internal conflict escalates, turning a simple undercover assignment into a matter of personal integrity. The hotel's destiny impacts not only its inhabitants but also Sanqing's longing for home. Yet, his indecision triggers a deeper crisis..

Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit.

programme.title: 唱K吧！黑道之哥

Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

Once Kwok's underachieving half-brother (Shawn YUE) and a suitcase full of tainted cash enter the picture, the chase turns deadly, with the brothers' tense family history coming to the surface as Kwok finds himself torn between the triads and his former police colleagues.

He hopes that the lab will finally find a cure for cancer, but he realizes that Ko Yuk is the only researcher that is actually trying to develop “super stem cells” to save lives. Meanwhile, her husband, “Sky Number One” president Tong Wing-cheung, is a ruthless businessman who puts money ahead of everything and will take any means necessary to get his way..

programme.desc: The film is originated from a famous Chinese Kung Fu fiction. Everybody fought for a pair of super weapons and wished to be the conquerror..

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..

programme.title: 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage..

programme.title: 正牌韋小寶之奉旨溝女
programme.desc: Imperial Court member Wai Siu-Bo is sent forward in time to present-day Hong Kong, to find a woman who can cure the Emperor of his illness. Can Siu-Bo accomplish his mission.

programme.title: 金三角群英會
programme.desc: BULLET and MOON are two tough ladies who are out to bust the biggest drug syndicate in Thailand and they only have ten days to do it! Nothing is beyond these fighting women as they enter the Golden triangle unafraid because they are on a “MISSION OF JUSTICE”! Through the jungle they pursue the dangerous Yie Feng as they track her into the very heart of Cala. Working under-cover they both find their lives at risk to the deadly Drug Lords. Only their superior fighting skills can keep them from being killed..

programme.title: 旺角卡門
programme.desc: A low-level trial 'big brother' has a hot-tempered 'littler brother' who can't keep out of trouble, and consequently is in constant need of being bailed out by his protector..

programme.title: 花心夢裏人
programme.desc: Fat Chiu and Frankie live together on a temporary basis. During their stay at home, they spend time with one of the home-mate Kwan and consequently build up very close relationship. Sally, who is Frankie's girlfriend, is deeply in romance with Frankie. However, when Pauline, a billionaire turns up, Frankie is crazily attracted by her. He decides to give up Sally. On the other hand, Fat Chiu immediately proceeds his plan and shows his care and love to Sally. Although Sally is so touched of the sincerity of Fat Chiu and accepts his offer, she knows she still loves Frankie. Kwan opines that Sally is damaging female dignity. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire..

programme.title: 新英雄本色
programme.desc: Cool and brave, Tong is the most famous big brother. Ha, a loyal follower of Tong, is charged murdering his unfaithful wife's lover. Fortunately, he is saved by Tong's lawyer..

programme.title: 伊波拉病毒
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Kai, a local gangster was caught in bed with his boss's wife, he killed both the boss and his wife. The boss's daughter Lily witnessed the murders and managed to escape afterwards. As the police were looking for him, Kai was forced to disappear... For the last ten years, Kai has worked in a Chinese restaurant in Johannesburg in South Africa after being smuggled into the country. The restaurant owner Brother Kei and his wife Ling takes advantage of Kai's situation and treat him badly. One day Kai goes to buy meat from a native tribe, he is unaware of that a terrible epidemic – the Ebola virus has broken out among the tribesmen. During the trip Kai rapes and murders a black girl who is infected with the disease. Kai has no idea he is carrying the disease, his body creates an antibody which means he is a carrier but the disease won't affect him..

programme.title: 影人映語 -點解「吳式」笑 － 吳君如
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer.

programme.title: 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage..

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..

programme.title: 江湖告急
programme.desc: The word is out: underworld kingpin Jimmy Yam will be killed in a day. He has a chance to see who the people around him really are and finds out who is behind the assassination..

programme.title: 安娜瑪德蓮娜
programme.desc: A romantic tale about 3 young people who starts out as adversaries and blossoms into something else. When a gorgeous female moves into the building and 2 men fall in love with her.

programme.title: 小偷阿星
programme.desc: Lung was an informer of Police in the triad society. But his identity was exposed and lost all memory after hurt. All of money that given by the Police was lost. The Police suspicious Lung had hidden the money. So he was wanted by the triad society and Police. Sing was a little thief, he knew Lung and made friend together. He knew everything about Lung then, and he wanted to help Lung to recover his memory aimed to take back the money. Fong was a manger in a big firm. He had stolen a large amount of money of his firm and was discovered by his colleague later. So he wanted to kill Wu but failed. Fong also wanted the money of Lung, as a result, he wanted to kill Lung also. Wu was saved by Lung and Sing. The Boss of Fong knew everything were exposed and ordered Koo to kill Lung, Sing and Wu. But Wu won't do that because of their friendship..

programme.title: 抱擁朝陽
programme.desc: Han Zhiyi‘s father took his life after he was rigged by Yi Zufen and Zhiyi was forced to close down her family business. She was distressed and went for a vacation with her mother. They left Shanghai and joined a cruise to Hong Kong. On the liner, she met billionaire Tong Paixian who fell deeply in love with her at first sight..

programme.title: 流氓醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.

programme.title: 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: 小男人周記
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: 偷神家族
programme.desc: Saint Hero is renowned for robbing the rich and giving to the poor. They uphold justice and fight crime. Che Hoi is head of Saint Hero with his odd couple daughters, Sim Lan and May as his assistants. All of them are excellent martial arts fighters. Without any trace of Saint Hero, Special Unit of the Police Force send their smartest man, Lethal Weapon, to cooperate with the most intelligent police woman, Super Canon. Another capable but odd couple swear to put Saint Hero to jail. However, they are the most capable but ‘destructive' police. All places that were under their investigation are badly ruined..

programme.title: 浪漫殺手自由人
programme.desc: After learning that his father was killed by the notorious Chinatown Triad, Nidaine becomes a cold-blooded killer determined to get his revenge. When one of his assassinations is witnessed by Jenny, Nidaine plans on silencing her forever. Instead, Nidaine finds himself falling for her, and they must now run for their lives from both the cops and the Triad assassins.

programme.title: 奸人本色
programme.desc: Leung Piu a swindler, cheats Yue Nan out of his life savings. This leads to Yue Nan's death, leaving his daughter Winnie behind. The Kang family, long disgusted by Leung's treachery, vow to avenge Yue Nan. They decide to “fight deceit with deceit”, exploiting Leung's greed to lure him into a trap, but Leung outsmarts Kang family. As the conflict escalates, Leung continuously sows discord between Kang's brothers Mon and Chuen. When Leung believes he has triumphed by triggering infighting within Kang family..

programme.title: 江湖告急
programme.desc: The word is out: underworld kingpin Jimmy Yam will be killed in a day. He has a chance to see who the people around him really are and finds out who is behind the assassination..

programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 古惑仔3之隻手遮天
programme.desc: The Hung Hing Club has just made Chan Ho Nam the 'keeper' of Causeway Bay. But, Dong Ying Club, Crow and Tiger open a karaoke club opposite to Chan's sticking a foot into his territory. On the other hand, Dong Ying succeeds in having Chang assassinated in Holland and frame Chan for his death. It's another challenge to Chan.

programme.title: 夜車
programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience..

programme.title: 整蠱專家
programme.desc: Jing Koo, is hired by Kam to get rid of Chi, to be the manager of the company. But he finds himself being cheated. He regains his confidence and competes with the 'King of Tricks'..

programme.title: 流氓公僕
programme.desc: Bill and Lee are a pair of old hands working with the Action Squad in the Police Department. They both have their shortcomings. Bill likes to bet a bit to lighten up and Lee likes to flirt with pretty girls. But their little tales do not in anyway interfere with their dedication towards their work. Unfortunately for them, a Pl Mak is newly appointed as their squad leader. To make matter worse, the new inspector is female. Bill and Lee have to adjust in a hurry how the new inspector likes to handle cases her way..

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: 火燒紅蓮寺
programme.desc: Rumors have it that the Shaolin Temple is harbouring revolutionaries. The emperor believes the rumors and decides to wipe out the temple. Fong Sai-yuk escapes with his uncle to the desert. There they run into Tou Tou. Yuk's uncle is killed by the king's general, and Tou and Yuk are captured. They are taken to the Red Lotus Temple; the temple is run by Elder Kung. Hung Hei Koon, has already joined Elder Kung and voluntarily becomes his protege. Yuk looks for every chance to escape but is stopped by Koon and Koon is just pretending to have joined Elder Kung. With Koon's help, Yuk finally defeats Elder Kung..

programme.title: 非常警察
programme.desc: Chicken, Wing and Zita worked in the same police station. Chicken used to make friends with many gangsters; Wing is a pro in computer knowledge; Zita came from a affluent family but devoted to her work. Zita was transferred to Chicken‘s team as their superintendent was termed “The Team in Vain”. Chicken was found to have committed a serious mistake in a mission and was sacked. Zita, as Chicken's girlfriend thought he would reform. However, to her disappointment, Zita discovered Chicken became a procurer in one of her missions. A series of murder was reported, the victims were all teenagers and were killed after they met with a friend from Internet. Wing was assigned to be the bait in this case..

programme.title: 我家有一隻河東獅
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses..

programme.title: 幻影特攻
programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: Foon, a Public Relations manager, starts a happy life with his wife Ann after remarrying her. Kwan, a new public relation officer in Foon's department, falls in love with Foon after he shields her from being criticized, when there is friction between Foon and Ann. Thus Foon falls in love with Kwan gradually. After a business trip to Tokyo, their relationship becomes much closer, while Ann meets Chu, a councilor, who falls in love with her but can't get Ann's response. When returning to Hong Kong, Kwan doesn't want to destroy Foon's family and decides to marry her fianc? When Foon is depressed by this, Ann finds out the truth. Another rupture breaks out again.

programme.title: 戀上你的床
programme.desc: Carrie left Raymond not because he had too many other women, but only because he slept with another woman right on the bed Carrie has always been obsessed with. After the break up, she begged for ownership of the bed she's gotten used to. Carrie was assigned to follow the story of city's celebrated super cop, Paul Ko. While exchanging fire he was shot at by an AK-47 and become a sexual impotent. During the process of interviewing, Carrie has fallen to Paul. Raymond is being considered for a promotion to district court, his superiors request for him to stay away from the night-life and women. In the thick of this difficult celibate period, an 18 year old girl called Tabby barges into Raymond's life..

programme.title: 帶子洪郎
programme.desc: Hung is a stuntman living with his troublesome father, Kwun. Five years ago, he deeply fell in love with May. Yet May's father strongly objected their relations and separated them trickily, with the help of Kwun. One day, May come backs - but with her six-year-old son, Sam. He begins to get back what he loses five years ago. May actually been badly ill before she comes back Hong Kong. Her only wish before die is to bring Sam back to Hung. After May has died, May's father insists to keep Sam by his sides. Hung tries his best to get back Sam. In order to earn more money, he does a very dangerous stunt. At last, he is injured..

programme.title: 川島芳子
programme.desc: Kawashima Yoshiko, the daughter of emperor Xu, was sent to Japan for training when she was an adolescent in order to rebuild Ching Empire. Yoshiko experienced many ups and downs, however, her life was a tragedy, ending up by being executed in Beijing when she was just forty-two.

programme.title: 特警新人類
programme.desc: To fight against the new era criminals, Inspector Chan struggles for picking up a group of brand new cadets to become his new team called the 'Gen-X-Cops'..

programme.title: 盲女七十二小時
programme.desc: Heung is temporarily blinded by an accident. While her doctor husband leaves Hong Kong for a meeting, an uninvited man arrives at their house. The man teases and tortures Heung, claiming that he is coming to avenge his wife..

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: Foon, a Public Relations manager, starts a happy life with his wife Ann after remarrying her. Kwan, a new public relation officer in Foon's department, falls in love with Foon after he shields her from being criticized, when there is friction between Foon and Ann. Thus Foon falls in love with Kwan gradually. After a business trip to Tokyo, their relationship becomes much closer, while Ann meets Chu, a councilor, who falls in love with her but can't get Ann's response. When returning to Hong Kong, Kwan doesn't want to destroy Foon's family and decides to marry her fianc? When Foon is depressed by this, Ann finds out the truth. Another rupture breaks out again.

programme.title: 鐵妹
programme.desc: The Story is set in the period during the Japanese invasion of China in the 1930's. A Chinese traitor Tung working within the puppet state of Manchukuo, gets involved in an affair with the mistress of a military officer. Their affair is exposed and in the confusion, Tung kills the officer and has to flee from the Japanese. In the desolate arid lands, his life is saved by Iron Sister, a member of guerrillas from a nearby hunting village, whom has an affair later with Tung. The humble villagers are very simple minded and only wished to drive out the Japanese. They fall easy prey, as Tung disguises his real identity and continues his secret contacts with his collaborators. One by one, the villagers become victims of Tung's ploy. Accidentally his plot is discovered by Iron Sister and they engage in a battle of life and death.

programme.title: 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: The Buddhist Monk and the Taoist Priest, both blessed with ghost-taming powers, have been quarrelling all over the landscape. Still, they are good friends. The Priest shepherds a group of corpses home. He has to fight off some vicious devils. The Priest's classmate has been assigned the job of accompanying the coffin of a prince back to the capital. One night, a thunderbolt rips the coffin and the prince becomes a vampire. He kills many people. The Priest asks to help. He finds his classmate has killed himself..

programme.title: 愛上我吧
programme.desc: Lobo and Skid are very close friends. They study in the same class, and they both grow up without their mothers. The two buddies often play in a band and play skateboards with their classmates. Soda, one of their classmates, has many girlfriends concurrently, and Suki is his closet girlfriend. Fion is another classmate. She is addicted to chat in phone with friends and strangers every day. She always thinks she will find a true love from playing line. One day, she has an argument with her boyfriend on street, and Pat, an innocent girl, saw the incident..

programme.title: 整蠱王
programme.desc: Happy specializes in playing tricks, but he refuses to work for rich man Shi. By coincidence, Happy meets Moon and falls for her. However, he is not aware it is just a trick..

programme.title: 川島芳子
programme.desc: Kawashima Yoshiko, the daughter of emperor Xu, was sent to Japan for training when she was an adolescent in order to rebuild Ching Empire. Yoshiko experienced many ups and downs, however, her life was a tragedy, ending up by being executed in Beijing when she was just forty-two.

programme.title: 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.

programme.title: 芭啦芭啦櫻之花
programme.desc: Phillip Wong, a colour-blind dance instructor who is devoted to the Japanese Para Para. He meets Yee, a spoiled rich girl and an attraction begins to form between the two..

programme.title: 最佳拍檔之千里救差婆
programme.desc: The invention of a prism - a special brain stimulant, gets King Kong and Inspector into a series of dangerous adventures. The lives of Inspector Ho and her son, Baldy Junior are also threatened by the villains..

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: This is the story of four aspiring young men striving to fight for their own goals. Kui and his family are intent upon emigrating to another country and they put all their energy in making as much money as possible in order to leave Hong Kong sooner. However just as their goal is about in sight, over-exertion causes Kui to fall ill...Keung is a smart and aggressive young man whose ambition is to make it in the world. But misfortune descends upon him when discovering that he and his family are duped by his boss...It has been a childhood dream of Chung to join the police force but his fragile frame of a body is far from satisfactory, so he turns to conducting traffic and handing out tickets to unfortunate drivers amid the bustles of the streets. However, his virtue is not appreciated...Wing is a diligent and self-absorbed student. His goal is to be one of the chosen few at his college's Music Department but he is dissuaded by his girlfriend's father. In the end he gives in and.

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳 II之父子情仇
programme.desc: Lee Rock realizes the promotion is indeed the manoeuvre of his surrender of power. So he decides it is the right time to resign. His son, Yin, has graduated and joins the ICAC...

programme.title: 九二黑玫瑰對黑玫瑰
programme.desc: As soon as Tony Leung, starts imitating the stilted dialogue of 60s heartthrob Lui Kei, film lovers know they've entered a circle of movie-in-jokes and self-conscious world.

programme.title: 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.

programme.title: 點指兵兵
programme.desc: A young man who was addicted to firearms wanted to be admitted to the police. He was not admitted because of his eye disease, which caused him psychological imbalance and he killed people everywhere. The police set up a special unit to arrest him. A fledgling policeman met the murderer on a narrow road..

programme.title: 八仙飯店之人肉叉燒包
programme.desc: In August 1985, a mutilated corpse is found on the beach of Macao. A police investigation uncovers the mysterious disappearance of the entire family of the Eight Immortals Restaurant. Based on a shocking and horrifying true story.

programme.title: 喋血街頭
programme.desc: In 1967, Hong Kong, Ben, Paul, and Frank are childhood friends and members of a gang. They regularly brawl with members of other gangs..

programme.title: 洗黑錢
programme.desc: David is a young lawyer who launders money for a gang leader in Chinatown. He is robbed and his assistant got killed when he carries a large sum of cash to Hong Kong. David turns to Waise, his law school buddy, for help. He doesn't realize that it is Waise who sets up the robbery. Petty, Waise's partner in the law firm, finds out that Waise has conducted some illegal activities. Before she could unveil the truth to the police, Petty is murdered. To cover up the truth, Waise finds Mandy, a promising solicitor, as scapegoat of Petty's death. Waise also sends out a gunman to track down Mandy. In a last minute rescue, Mandy is saved by one of her client, Dragon. She always finds the client obnoxious, but now she has to team up with Dragon to fight back and to prove her innocence at the same time..

programme.title: 奇門遁甲
programme.desc: Two elderly Taoist priests, Chi Men and Dun Jia, who learn their magic from the same teacher always quarrel with each other. They provide mirth and expert kung fu tuition to young man who is mistakenly presumed to be the crown prince of the Imperial Court, missing since childhood. The emperor dispatches an eunuch with the magic powers to apprehend the young man. But he must first deal with Chi Men and Dun Jia who are the young man's protector..

programme.title: 男人四十
programme.desc: Secondary school teacher Lam Yiu-kwok is suffering from a mid-life crisis - his peers have all become more successful than him; his relationship with his wife, Chan Man-ching, is in trouble when her old flame returns, and he finds himself tempted by a 17-year-old student who has a crush on him..

programme.title: 暴風眼
programme.desc: Few years ago, Sergeant Kong in a mission to capture the head of the “East Rail Corporation” met with Yip Fung who killed the head of East Rail instead. Kong shot at Yip but missed and only a finger was left in the scene. Kong suspected that Yip might be a robot and thus kept a close watch on her, but later turned that he fell in love with Yip. One night, Ko Kit accompanied with four assistants launched a campaign to steal the “Crystal” in East Rail Main Building. Ko was successful in breaking through the security system and got the crystal but at the same time Yip also rushed to join in the robbery..

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: So, the legendary beggar, is actually born in a princely rich family. Like his father, So leads a lavish life. He once meets Ju Suan and falls in love with the virgin prostitute.

programme.title: 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious..

programme.title: 新最佳拍檔
programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 八彩林亞珍
programme.desc: Jenny, with the plain looks but a heart of gold, she is always in between jobs. Once she gets a job, her knack of creating awkward situations immediately loses it for her. Fang is her suitor, but he gets nowhere as the girl has no time for love, so Fang goes along with her in job hunting. A big group called Sanda wants to take over the whole city through take-over deals. They are ruthless and have thrown thousands into the streets. Jenny and Fang, bungling as they are, become the vanguard of a movement against the great conglomerate. They were even being hunted by the group and their life was threatened..

programme.title: 四人新世界
programme.desc: Fei is the master cook in Hong Kong, while his son Suckling has established himself as a real estate salesman in Canada. Suckling sends for his father to join him in this new chapter of their lives. Happily, Fei hops on a plane to Canada. During the flight, he has the good fortune of meeting Yim Chau, a young woman traveling to join her aunt in Canada. Subsequently, Fei meets Yim Chau's aunt and Suckling meets Yim Chau. Suckling loves Yim Chau but is too shy to express his feelings. When Yim Chau announces she falls in love with Richard, Suckling feels heartbroken but still helps her with dating preparations. However, when he discovers Richard cheating her, Suckling fights him. At the same time, he is being chased by the bank for debts..

programme.title: 黃蜂尾後針
programme.desc: When Yau argues with his wife Jessica for the uneven share of dirty money, he shoots her in coma. To find out the money, Yau hires Sister Ma to look after her..

programme.title: 九龍冰室
programme.desc: Ex-convict Dragon works as a waiter after his release from prison. He has no idea that he is now a father, until his six-year-old son greets him 'Dad' upon his release..

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: So, the legendary beggar, is actually born in a princely rich family. Like his father, So leads a lavish life. He once meets Ju Suan and falls in love with the virgin prostitute.

programme.title: 奇門遁甲
programme.desc: Two elderly Taoist priests, Chi Men and Dun Jia, who learn their magic from the same teacher always quarrel with each other. They provide mirth and expert kung fu tuition to young man who is mistakenly presumed to be the crown prince of the Imperial Court, missing since childhood. The emperor dispatches an eunuch with the magic powers to apprehend the young man. But he must first deal with Chi Men and Dun Jia who are the young man's protector..

programme.title: 藍色霹靂火
programme.desc: Jody was a fashion model who was found dead in the apartment. Investigation of this murder case was taken up by Superintendent Ching, assisted by Dillon who had just passed from the Police Training School. They located Lam, Jody's ex-husband, who agreed to assist Ching after persuasion. They found Ellen, a fashion model who lived with Jody. She was not willing to talk. On the other side, the murderer is planning to kill Ellen..

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 猛鬼撞鬼
programme.desc: Taxi dancer Yue puts herself head over heels in debt because of gambling. She tries to borrow a loan from her close friend, Ngor, with tricks of suicide. She pretendedly pushes Ngor down a tall building but falls from the rooftop herself. She has got a narrow escape and a windfall of picking up a sack of money from a Chinese spiritualized vase which belongs to a big brother, Hung. With the help of the spirit, Yue and Ngor win so much that they almost lose their sense. They want to keep the vase themselves so they must get away from the pursuit of a killer sent by Hung, as well as another two mysterious detectives..

programme.title: 契媽唔易做
programme.desc: A Chinese illegal immigrant “Cousin” wrongly trusted his friend Kwok to rob a jewellery shop. Kwok managed to escape and Cousin is so scared to hide himself in the vehicle which is rented by Ah Ching to remove to the rural area. Ah Ching is suffered by the high pressure from her work and city life. She also has to worry about her boyfriend Fai who is a police inspector. She is determined to pack up and move into remote area to escape from all this. She doesn't know a stranger (Cousin) is right at her back. Ah Ching meets with Pak Lam who is reared in the village by his greedy father Uncle Tat. Ah Ching finds it so ridiculous that naturally she sympathizes the kid. Pak Lam visits Ah Ching's new home to play TV games. He bumped into the scared Cousin who is still hiding there. He and Pak Lam come into an agreement not to reveal his identity to the others. Cousin has no attention to hurt anybody. He even stands out to protect Ah Ching and Pak Lam when the gangs in the village tr.

programme.title: A計劃
programme.desc: This is Hong Kong at the turn of the century. The South China Sea is crawling with smugglers, cut-throats and pirates and none is more successful than the gang led by the notorious pirate Lo. Government forces invariably lose to Lo. Finally the Government looks the other way whenever Lo is around. Young seaman Jackie Chan, so far better known for his bar room fights, resigns from the Marine Force. He plans to stage a personal vendetta against Lo. Jackie gets the help of Samo Hung, little knowing Samo has his own axe to grind. Jackie and Samo suffer an inglorious drubbing in the hands of Lo. Jackie, now completely incensed, decides to don the uniform once again. He finds young commander Yuen Biao sympathetic to his cause but adamant against his antics..

programme.title: A 計劃續集
programme.desc: A group of Chinese revolutionaries are being bunted by agents of the Dowager Empress, and Jackie has to use all his courage, wits and physical prowess to keep the peace..

programme.title: 虎度門
programme.desc: Lang Kim Sang, a famous Cantonese Opera actress, strives to revitalize the traditional art. She hires a new director but stirs up resentment and jealousy within the troupe..

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely..

programme.title: 神偷次世代
programme.desc: Mac, a professional thief, and three others organize commercial thieves together. While stealing a cancer vaccine, they find a pre-set bomb which it is a setup against them..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 情義心
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taiwan. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky..

programme.title: 絕代雙驕
programme.desc: Master, The of Eva Palace enters the valley in search of 10 Untouchable Villians. Despite being married and having a child together, she and Yin fight each other without remorse.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Glaciers
programme.desc: Glaciers possess a very special kind of “power.” They have acted as a catalyst for the birth and evolution of life on Earth. Glaciers are the source of human life and one of the most important partners in the Earth's climate system. However, due to global warming, glaciers are gradually disappearing. What, then, is happening to glaciers? This documentary explores what we must do to prevent the disappearance of glaciers, which may threaten the future of the Earth.

programme.title: Save This Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Back in Eastern Europe, Catfish and Rooftop start their visit Ukraine dropping into the country via skydive. The adventures only get crazier from there- from wrangling pigs and racing ostriches to testing out if their heads can survive a Spetsnaz bottle break. After testing out the bottle break the duo move onto sambo, a Soviet style of wrestling and equally challenging event. The BMX bikers become the first people to trick at Chernobyl (and get a lifetime ban), but before they head out to their next stop, the two finish their trip just like they came in- airborne. Only this time they’re leaving by fighter jet.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: With their travels taking them to Asia, Rooftop and Catfish find themselves spending several dangerous days in Bangladesh. The pair put their bodies and safety to the test harvesting honey the Bangladeshi way, transporting workers via row boat, deconstructing ships for scrap metal, and trying to clean one of the country’s rare public restrooms. They test out Bangladeshi cuisine in the form of fish, cow stomach, and goat brain curry, and race some locals on their rickshaw bikes. The trip concludes with Rooftop and Catfish heading out of town by train- only running across the top. With all of Bangladesh’s physical dangers, can the BMX bikers make it out without a hospital visit.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.
